name: N-carbamoyl-D-α-amino… to acyl-CoA
summary: A 5-step route from N-carbamoyl-D-α-amino acid anion to acyl-CoA(4−), ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: N-carbamoyl-D-amino-acid hydrolase
reactions.equation: an N-carbamoyl-D-amino acid + H2O + 2 H(+) = a D-alpha-amino acid + NH4(+) + CO2

reactions.name: a D-alpha-amino acid + A + H2O = a 2-oxocarboxylate + AH2 + NH4(+)
reactions.equation: a D-alpha-amino acid + A + H2O = a 2-oxocarboxylate + AH2 + NH4(+)

reactions.name: pyruvate decarboxylase
reactions.equation: a 2-oxocarboxylate + H(+) = an aldehyde + CO2

reactions.name: aldehyde dehydrogenase (NADP(+))
reactions.equation: an aldehyde + NADP(+) + H2O = a carboxylate + NADPH + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: acid--CoA ligase (GDP-forming)
reactions.equation: a carboxylate + GTP + CoA = an acyl-CoA + GDP + phosphate

reactions.name: D-aminoacyl-tRNA deacylase
reactions.equation: a D-aminoacyl-tRNA + H2O = a tRNA + a D-alpha-amino acid + H(+)

reactions.name: D-amino acid dehydrogenase (quinone)
reactions.equation: a D-alpha-amino acid + a quinone + H2O = a 2-oxocarboxylate + a quinol + NH4(+)

reactions.name: guanosine deaminase
reactions.equation: guanosine + H2O + H(+) = xanthosine + NH4(+)

reactions.name: nitrite reductase (cytochrome; ammonia-forming)
reactions.equation: 6 Fe(III)-[cytochrome c] + NH4(+) + 2 H2O = 6 Fe(II)-[cytochrome c] + nitrite + 8 H(+)

reactions.name: 2-oxoaldehyde dehydrogenase (NADP(+))
reactions.equation: 2-oxoaldehyde + NADP(+) + H2O = a 2-oxocarboxylate + NADPH + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: L-2-hydroxycarboxylate dehydrogenase (NAD(+))
reactions.equation: a (2S)-2-hydroxycarboxylate + NAD(+) = a 2-oxocarboxylate + NADH + H(+)

reactions.name: quinoline 2-oxidoreductase
reactions.equation: quinoline + A + H2O = quinolin-2(1H)-one + AH2

reactions.name: taurine dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: taurine + A + H2O = sulfoacetaldehyde + AH2 + NH4(+)

reactions.name: alcohol dehydrogenase (NADP(+))
reactions.equation: a primary alcohol + NADP(+) = an aldehyde + NADPH + H(+)

reactions.name: primary-amine oxidase
reactions.equation: a primary methyl amine + O2 + H2O = an aldehyde + H2O2 + NH4(+)

reactions.name: aspartoacylase
reactions.equation: an N-acyl-L-aspartate + H2O = a carboxylate + L-aspartate

reactions.name: N-acyl-D-glutamate deacylase
reactions.equation: an N-acyl-D-glutamate + H2O = D-glutamate + a carboxylate

reactions.name: glycerol-3-phosphate 1-O-acyltransferase
reactions.equation: sn-glycerol 3-phosphate + an acyl-CoA = a 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate + CoA

reactions.name: sterol O-acyltransferase
reactions.equation: an acyl-CoA + cholesterol = a cholesterol ester + CoA

reactions.name: a D-alpha-amino acid + O2 = a 2-iminocarboxylate + H2O2
reactions.equation: a D-alpha-amino acid + O2 = a 2-iminocarboxylate + H2O2

reactions.name: tryptophan dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: L-tryptophan + NAD(+) + H2O = indole-3-pyruvate + NH4(+) + NADH + H(+)

reactions.name: tryptophan dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: L-tryptophan + NADP(+) + H2O = indole-3-pyruvate + NH4(+) + NADPH + H(+)

reactions.name: (8Z,11Z,14Z)-heptadecatrienal + A + H2O = (8Z,11Z,14Z)-heptadecatrienoate + AH2 + H(+)
reactions.equation: (8Z,11Z,14Z)-heptadecatrienal + A + H2O = (8Z,11Z,14Z)-heptadecatrienoate + AH2 + H(+)

reactions.name: steroid 9alpha-monooxygenase
reactions.equation: pregna-4,9(11)-diene-3,20-dione + AH2 + O2 = 9,11alpha-epoxypregn-4-ene-3,20-dione + A + H2O

reactions.name: D-2-hydroxyacid dehydrogenase (NAD(+))
reactions.equation: a (2R)-2-hydroxycarboxylate + NAD(+) = a 2-oxocarboxylate + NADH + H(+)

reactions.name: a 2-hydroxy carboxylate + O2 = a 2-oxocarboxylate + H2O2
reactions.equation: a 2-hydroxy carboxylate + O2 = a 2-oxocarboxylate + H2O2

reactions.name: thyroxine 5'-deiodinase
reactions.equation: 3,3',5-triiodo-L-thyronine + iodide + A + H(+) = L-thyroxine + AH2

reactions.name: L-pipecolate dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: L-pipecolate + A = L-1-piperideine-6-carboxylate + AH2 + H(+)

reactions.name: nitroalkane oxidase
reactions.equation: a primary nitroalkane + O2 + H2O = an aldehyde + nitrite + H2O2 + H(+)

reactions.name: monoamine oxidase
reactions.equation: a secondary aliphatic amine + O2 + H2O = a primary amine + an aldehyde + H2O2

reactions.name: acyl-phosphate--hexose phosphotransferase
reactions.equation: a D-hexose + an acyl phosphate = a D-hexose phosphate + a carboxylate + H(+)
